output.reason: The cited list item [ev-1b4fb5cb096e] is a bare metric name, but its section introduction [ev-1f419676f177] says what changes. Metrics listed with the `cortex_` prefix will now start with `loki_`, so this metric becomes `loki_prometheus_rule_evaluations_total`. Only setups that leave `metrics_namespace` at its default `loki` are exposed; setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name. If the operator does nothing, anything that queries the old name stops finding it. [ev-1f419676f177] also says the `metrics_namespace` setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release, so the `cortex` workaround is temporary.
